transcript.text: This is Swift, an automated flood assistant working with local emergency services. Am I speaking with someone at 1322 Tumbling Rapids Drive?
Yeah, this is me at 1322 Tumbling Rapids Drive, just me here, no one else, and the water’s not in yet—though I do have a boat if you need to get me out, no truck though.
Got it, you’re at 1322 Tumbling Rapids Drive. How many people are at the home right now, including anyone who can't come to the phone?
Just me here at the house, no one else, and I’m fine—no water inside, and I can help if you need a boat, though no truck’s available.
Sorry, I didn't catch that. How many people are at the home right now, including anyone who can't come to the phone?
Just me here, all by myself, no one else around — and I’m totally fine, no water in the house either.
Is there anyone there who can't leave on their own, for example someone who uses a wheelchair, needs oxygen, or is bedbound? If it's a wheelchair, does it have a motor?
No one here can’t leave on their own, and I’m the only person—no wheelchair, no oxygen, no bedbound folks, and I’m fine, just me.
Understood, you’re the only person here and fine. Is there water inside the home right now?
No water inside at all, just me here, and I’m good — no need for a truck, but hey, if you’ve got a boat, I’m all ears, though I’m not sure how that’d help since I’m not even near water.
You’re all set here, no water inside. If neighbors need a ride out, do you have a high-clearance truck, a boat, or free seats in a vehicle?
No water inside, just me here, but I’ve got a boat—I can help if anyone needs a ride out, just say the word!
Thanks for offering to help others if needed. Let me read that back: people at the home not confirmed; no water inside yet; you can help with a boat. Is that right?
Yeah, that’s right—just me here, no water in yet, and I can help with a boat if needed, though I don’t have a truck or any seats to spare.

Got it, you’re here and ready to help with a boat if needed. I've recorded that you may be able to help neighbors. A dispatcher may contact you. Only go out if it's safe for you, and never drive into water you can't see the bottom of. Goodbye.
